overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance indicates that deep relationship dynamics, specifically husband-wife emotional realism ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' with 1767 views and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' with 1674 views), significantly outperform generic heartbreak shayari or single-line poetry. Family and relationship reality checks generate consistent traction compared to low-sample poetic pieces.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,767 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,674 views) achieved the highest view counts on the channel.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more content focusing on unspoken marital realities, post-marriage emotional shifts, and domestic psychological nuances.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota' achieved 385 views, outperforming standard abstract shayari.
winning_patterns.action: Use conversational, podcast-style framing addressing daily relationship compromises.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 19 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic, cryptic poetry hooks; ground the emotion in tangible, everyday scenarios.
